Let's study a two-part problem; the purpose of Knowledge (Episteme) in Human Life, and the Tools we use (Citing Zettelkasten and the World-Wide-Web as massively complex examples.)

In Abstract form, a Web is a System of Communication.

However, when a few hundred notes...

How did Luhmann avoid losing Orientation or Duplicating writings, in his vast Analog Zettelkasten?

Perhaps the digital space today, affords simply too many directions for medium (This is something like "Cyber-Entropy".); The Power of Technology is infact so Unlimited, it is Volatile (Much like early Nuclear Science.) This ironically degrades the original signal-or-purpose; To externalize into writing, is not to "think" but to record our thinking.
